nodes.name: annotate.js
nodes.summary: CLI 标注工具入口：解析命令行参数（--article, --quote, --comment, --author, --evolution），创建评论文档并写入 comments 目录，自动分配递增序号。

nodes.name: convert.js
nodes.summary: CLI 转换工具入口：扫描 buffer 目录中的 session-*.md 文件，将其解析为 Echo 格式的文章并写入 articles 目录，自动跳过空文件和未变更文件。

nodes.name: import-sessions.js
nodes.summary: CLI 导入工具入口：从 ~/.claude/projects/ 下读取 Claude Code 的 JSONL 会话记录，清洗系统噪音和用户/助手消息块，转化为 Echo 格式文章。
nodes.languageNotes: 包含会话清洗管线：过滤系统提示噪音、规范化用户消息（多块拼接）、去重助手输出块、解析逐行 JSONL 事件流并重建对话轮次。

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: CLI 索引工具入口：读取所有文章和评论，为每篇文章生成评论区链接列表（含批注引用链），更新文章末尾的 ECHO_COMMENTS 标记区块。

nodes.name: anchor.js
nodes.summary: 锚点解析领域逻辑：去除行内格式（粗体/斜体/删除线），在文章正文中定位引用文本位置，通过前缀/后缀消歧和行号提示进行多候选排序。

nodes.name: echo-format.js
nodes.summary: Echo 文章格式领域模型：定义 Echo 文章、对话轮次和参与者数据结构，提供创建/序列化为 Markdown（含 YAML frontmatter）的完整工厂函数，以及标题和摘要自动推断。
nodes.languageNotes: 定义了完整的 Echo Article/Turn/Participant 数据模型。toMarkdown() 序列化器输出带 frontmatter 和元数据注解的标准 Markdown 格式。包含从对话标题前缀自动推断标题/摘要的启发式逻辑。

nodes.name: validation.js
nodes.summary: 数据校验领域逻辑：验证文章和标注评论的必填字段、ID 格式、evolution 引用类型，检测评论间的循环引用、悬空引用和重复 ID。
nodes.languageNotes: 包含深度优先的循环引用检测算法（detectCycle），以及对 evolution 引用链和文章引用有效性的交叉验证。

nodes.name: workspace.js
nodes.summary: 工作区路径解析基础设施：统一解析 Echo 工作区根目录，支持环境变量 ECHO_WORKSPACE、echo.json 配置和默认路径三层优先级，提供 expandHome、ensureDir、项目 ID 生成等工具函数。
nodes.languageNotes: 三层路径解析优先级：ECHO_WORKSPACE 环境变量 > echo.json 配置 > ~/.echo-workspace 默认值。expandHome 处理 ~ 波浪号展开。

nodes.name: convert-buffer.js
nodes.summary: Buffer 转换用例：将 session buffer 中的原始 Markdown 对话解析为结构化的对话轮次列表，再调用 echo-format 工厂函数构建正式文章。

nodes.name: init-workspace.js
nodes.summary: 工作区初始化用例：创建 Echo 工作区目录结构（articles/comments/index/session-buffer），生成默认 echo.json 配置文件。

nodes.name: strip-comments.js
nodes.summary: 评论剥离工具函数：通过正则替换移除 Markdown 正文中的 ECHO_COMMENTS_START/END 区块，供锚点解析使用以确保在原始正文中定位引用。

nodes.name: resolve.js
nodes.summary: CLI 锚点解析工具入口：对所有评论的引用锚点进行定位验证，报告 ok/broken/needs_review/ambiguous 四种状态，验证引文在对应文章中存在。

nodes.name: search.js
nodes.summary: CLI 搜索工具入口：支持 --keyword 全文搜索和 --tag 标签过滤，输出匹配文章列表及关键词上下文片段。

nodes.name: validate.js
nodes.summary: CLI 校验工具入口：加载所有文章和评论，运行完整校验套件（字段验证、重复 ID、循环引用、悬空引用），输出通过或失败及错误详情。

nodes.name: stripInlineFormatting
nodes.summary: 去除 Markdown 行内格式标记（粗体、斜体、删除线），返回纯文本用于锚点匹配。

nodes.name: findAllPositions
nodes.summary: 在文本中查找引用字符串的所有出现位置，返回包含行号和字符索引的数组。

nodes.name: resolveAnchor
nodes.summary: 解析评论锚点到文章正文中的具体位置：先格式化去除 Markdown 标记，再通过前后缀消歧和行号提示选择最佳匹配。

nodes.name: createTurn
nodes.summary: 创建 Echo 对话轮次对象：解析原始文本中的角色、模型和内容前缀，返回标准化的 Turn 数据结构。

nodes.name: createArticle
nodes.summary: 创建 Echo 文章对象：从 session 元数据和对话轮次构建完整的 Article 结构，包含 ID 生成、参与者去重、标题/摘要自动推断和时间戳。

nodes.name: toMarkdown
nodes.summary: 将 Article 对象序列化为标准 Echo Markdown 格式，包括 YAML frontmatter、对话轮次块和评论区占位标记。

nodes.name: stripPrefix
nodes.summary: 从多行文本中去除对话约定前缀（如模型名标记），支持单行和多行两种剥离策略。

nodes.name: validateAnnotation
nodes.summary: 校验单条标注评论：检查必填字段（id/author/created_at/target/anchor）、ID 格式（ann-NNN）和 evolution.kind 合法值。

nodes.name: validateArticle
nodes.summary: 校验文章记录：确保 id 存在且 title 不为空。

nodes.name: detectCycle
nodes.summary: 递归检测评论引用图中是否存在循环依赖，返回检测到的环路径。
nodes.languageNotes: 使用深度优先搜索（DFS）配合 visited 集合检测有向图中的环。

nodes.name: checkAllCycles
nodes.summary: 对所有评论 ID 批量执行循环引用检测，收集所有发现的环并生成错误报告。

nodes.name: checkEvolutionReferences
nodes.summary: 验证 evolution.of 引用的目标评论 ID 确实存在于评论集合中，检测悬空引用。

nodes.name: checkArticleReferences
nodes.summary: 验证评论 target.article_id 引用的文章 ID 确实存在于文章集合中。

nodes.name: checkDuplicateIds
nodes.summary: 检测所有记录中是否存在重复的 ID，确保每个文章和评论 ID 全局唯一。

nodes.name: resolveEchoHomePath
nodes.summary: 解析 Echo 主目录路径：优先使用 ECHO_HOME 环境变量，否则默认为 ~/.echo-workspace。

nodes.name: resolveWorkspacePath
nodes.summary: 解析当前项目的工作区路径：三层优先级（环境变量 > echo.json 配置 > 默认路径），支持波浪号展开。

nodes.name: getConfig
nodes.summary: 读取工作区 echo.json 配置文件并返回解析后的 JSON 对象，文件不存在时返回空对象。

nodes.name: ensureDir
nodes.summary: 确保目录存在：不存在时递归创建。

nodes.name: parseBuffer
nodes.summary: 解析 session buffer 文件：按空行分割为对话块，识别 turn 边界并提取 speaker 名称和内容。

nodes.name: buildArticle
nodes.summary: 从 buffer 文件名和对话轮次构建完整的 Echo 文章：提取 session 日期，调用 echo-format 工厂生成 Markdown。

nodes.name: initWorkspace
nodes.summary: 初始化 Echo 工作区：创建子目录（session-buffer/articles/comments/index），生成默认配置，验证并迁移旧版 echo.yaml 配置。

nodes.name: stripCommentSections
nodes.summary: 从文章正文中剥离 ECHO_COMMENTS 区块，返回纯净正文供锚点解析使用。

nodes.name: isSystemNoise
nodes.summary: 判断文本是否为系统噪音内容（system-reminder、hook 输出等），通过前缀和模式匹配过滤。

nodes.name: cleanUserMessage
nodes.summary: 清洗用户消息内容：处理 content 可能是字符串或数组的情况，提取文本块并拼接。

nodes.name: cleanAssistantBlocks
nodes.summary: 清洗助手消息块数组：过滤空文本，合并连续的文本块为单个消息，移除思考块。

nodes.name: parseSession
nodes.summary: 解析 Claude Code JSONL 会话文件：逐行读取事件流，重建用户-助手对话轮次，过滤系统噪音，提取模型信息。
nodes.languageNotes: 核心解析逻辑：逐行 JSON.parse + 事件类型分发（user/assistant/system），内部使用闭包函数 flushAssistant/flushUser 管理待处理块的累加和输出。

nodes.name: buildArticle
nodes.summary: 将解析后的会话数据构建为 Echo 文章对象：从 session 文件名提取 ID 和日期，调用 echo-format 工厂生成完整文章。

nodes.name: buildCommentList
nodes.summary: 为指定文章构建评论区 Markdown：筛选关联评论，生成带引用链、作者和日期的列表，处理 evolution 引用关系。

nodes.name: session-e5239574.md
nodes.summary: 2026-05-20 的 AI 对话记录，共 15 条发言和 14 条回复。记录了用户与 DeepSeek V4 Pro 协作探索 Echo 原型项目的完整过程，包括阅读项目文档、使用 gstack 探查项目结构、以及推进开发任务。

nodes.name: template-conversation.md
nodes.summary: Echo 对话文章的标准格式模板。定义了 YAML frontmatter 结构（id、title、participants）、turn 标记语法（speaker、reply_to 属性）、以及人机对话的内容格式规范，是所有文章生成脚本的格式基准。

nodes.name: 001-format-alignment.md
nodes.summary: 记录了 convert.js 和 import-sessions.js 两个数据来源在生成文章格式上的 5 项不一致问题：参与者字段格式、turn 标记语法、created_at 日期 Bug、summary 统一性、source_session 字段缺失。已提出以 ECHO_FORMAT.md 为统一规范的解决方案。

nodes.name: 002-hook-verification.md
nodes.summary: 记录了 Echo hook 系统的两个待验证功能：SessionStart 状态通知和 capture_enabled 捕获开关。描述了为什么当前会话无法完整测试（hook 由 Claude Code 事件触发且无法中途回滚），并提供了完整的验证测试流程脚本。

nodes.name: 003-shared-article-renderer.md
nodes.summary: 记录了共享 article 渲染模块的设计方案。针对 convert.js 和 import-sessions.js 中约 40 行重复的 Markdown 拼接代码，提出 JSON template + 单序列化器架构，由 echo-format.js 作为唯一的序列化出口，消除 001 号问题的根因。

nodes.name: anchor.test.js
nodes.summary: anchor.js 模块的单元测试文件，覆盖内联格式剥离、引用文本定位、锚点消歧（含 prefix/suffix 消歧和 line_hint 回退）以及重复引用无法消歧的异常路径。共 10 个测试用例。

nodes.name: echo-format.test.js
nodes.summary: echo-format.js 模块的单元测试文件，覆盖 turn 归一化（去除前缀、幂等性）、article 创建、Markdown 序列化、标题和摘要推断、以及会话日期提取。共 10 个测试用例。

nodes.name: init-workspace.test.js
nodes.summary: init-workspace.js 模块的单元测试文件，验证工作区初始化逻辑：首次创建目录和配置文件、已存在时不重复创建、以及缺少 echo.json 时的配置补全行为。

nodes.name: workspace.test.js
nodes.summary: workspace.js 模块的单元测试文件，验证路径解析核心工具函数：tilde 展开、Echo 主目录解析、项目 ID 推导、项目数据根目录计算、以及工作区路径解析。

nodes.name: capture.js
nodes.summary: Hook capture script that reads Claude Code hook events from stdin, buffers UserPromptSubmit and Stop events, extracts assistant responses from transcript files, and writes session turns to the workspace buffer directory.

nodes.name: status.js
nodes.summary: Hook status script that reads Claude Code SessionStart events from stdin, parses ECHO_STATUS.md to extract project progress (done, in-progress, todo), and reports contextual status with capture state and project info.

nodes.name: config.js
nodes.summary: Configuration module providing capture toggle (isCaptureEnabled / setCaptureEnabled) and speaker list retrieval, backed by the workspace echo.json file.

nodes.name: markdown-store.js
nodes.summary: Markdown file store providing article and comment listing, reading with gray-matter frontmatter parsing, ID-based lookup, annotation ID generation, and search indexing over the workspace directory structure.

nodes.name: project-registry.js
nodes.summary: Project registration system maintaining a registry.json that maps project paths to workspace data directories, with longest-prefix matching for resolving a given filesystem path to its owning registered project.

nodes.name: markdown-store.test.js
nodes.summary: Test suite for markdown-store.js validating article listing, reading with frontmatter, comment loading, article-by-ID lookup, and annotation ID generation across multiple temp-directory test fixtures.

nodes.name: project-registry.test.js
nodes.summary: Test suite for project-registry.js covering project registration, duplicate name handling, longest-prefix path matching, workspace data directory creation, and edge cases with mock filesystem environments.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package configuration defining the echo-prototype project's npm scripts (all, convert, validate, index, resolve, annotate, import), binary entry point (echo-mcp), and dependencies including gray-matter and commander.

nodes.name: USAGE_GUIDE_V3.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive 12-section usage guide covering workspace initialization, project registration, hook installation, capture routing validation, session status reporting, full pipeline operations, edge cases, and architecture reference with step-by-step shell command examples.

nodes.name: extractAuqBlock
nodes.summary: Reads the Claude Code transcript file, parses each line as JSON, filters assistant messages, and extracts new blocks of text since the last recorded count for session buffering.

nodes.name: handleStop
nodes.summary: Handles the Stop hook event: reads the session file for existing turns, extracts new assistant messages from the transcript, formats a new turn with user/assistant speakers, and appends it to the session buffer.

nodes.name: getSessionFile
nodes.summary: Resolves or creates a session tracking file for a given session ID, maintaining a persistent map of session IDs to local session counters with date-based naming.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the capture hook: checks if capture is enabled, reads hook data from stdin, resolves the buffer root, and routes to the appropriate handler (UserPromptSubmit, Stop, or StopFailure).

nodes.name: handleUserPromptSubmit
nodes.summary: Handles the UserPromptSubmit hook event by creating a prompt directory for the session and writing the user's prompt data as JSON for later retrieval during Stop processing.

nodes.name: parseStatusFile
nodes.summary: Parses an ECHO_STATUS.md file to extract categorized task lists (done, in-progress, todo sections) by matching markdown checkbox patterns against section headings.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Entry point for the status hook: reads hook data from stdin, checks capture state, resolves the target project, parses ECHO_STATUS.md, and outputs formatted progress context with in-progress and todo task summaries.

nodes.name: listMarkdownFiles
nodes.summary: Recursively walks a directory to collect all .md file paths, skipping hidden directories, returning an array of resolved absolute paths.

nodes.name: loadArticles
nodes.summary: Loads all articles from a directory by scanning .md files, parsing frontmatter via gray-matter, filtering by type=article, and returning records with id, title, tags, content, and relative paths.

nodes.name: loadArticleById
nodes.summary: Looks up a single article by its frontmatter id field, scanning all .md files in the directory and returning the first match with parsed metadata and content.

nodes.name: loadComments
nodes.summary: Loads all comment/annotation .md files from a directory, parsing frontmatter for id, article reference, author, quote, and returning structured comment records with relative paths.

nodes.name: nextAnnotationId
nodes.summary: Scans existing annotation files in the comments directory and generates the next sequential annotation ID (e.g., ann-012) by incrementing the highest existing numeric suffix.

nodes.name: loadRegistry
nodes.summary: Loads the project registry from registry.json, with graceful handling of unknown properties and automatic renaming of corrupted registry files for recovery.

nodes.name: registerProject
nodes.summary: Registers a project path in the registry: resolves or creates a project ID from the directory name with collision suffixes, creates workspace subdirectories (session-buffer, articles, comments, index), and persists the entry with timestamp.

nodes.name: findProjectForPath
nodes.summary: Finds the owning registered project for a given filesystem path using longest-prefix matching across all registered project roots, returning the project entry with its data root path.

nodes.name: ECHO_STATUS.md
nodes.summary: Project status tracker documenting all completed milestones, in-progress work, pending features, and technical debt for the Echo knowledge forum.

nodes.name: echo-mcp.js
nodes.summary: Main CLI entry point routing 15+ subcommands (hook, init, doctor, capture, mcp, convert, validate, resolve, search) for the Echo knowledge forum.

nodes.name: errors.js
nodes.summary: Domain-level error class NotFoundError extending Error, used across Echo usecases for resource-not-found conditions mapped to JSON-RPC error codes.

nodes.name: echo-paths.js
nodes.summary: Unified path resolver for Echo workspace data directories (articles, comments, buffer, index) with dependency injection and project registry support.

nodes.name: server.js
nodes.summary: MCP server implementing JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio transport with request dispatching, tool routing, error handling, and protocol compliance.

nodes.name: tools.js
nodes.summary: Schema definitions and handler mappings for 5 MCP tools (search_articles, get_article, get_article_context, list_tags, list_recent) with input schemas and descriptions.

nodes.name: mcp-server.js

tour.title: CLI Entry Point
tour.description: The CLI entry point is where every Echo command begins execution. This file parses command-line arguments and dispatches to the appropriate usecase handler either installing the Claude Code capture hooks or running the doctor health check. It provides the starting point for understanding what commands Echo supports and how the program is structured.

tour.title: Hook Installer
tour.description: Building on the CLI entry from Step 1, this usecase automates the installation of Claude Code hooks that capture conversations in real time. It writes the echo-capture.sh hook script into the Claude Code configuration directory so that every future Claude session automatically feeds its transcript into Echo session buffer. This is the bridge between Claude Code and Echo knowledge pipeline.

tour.title: Health Check Doctor
tour.description: The doctor usecase verifies that the Echo workspace is correctly configured. It checks that required directories exist, the configuration file is present, and the capture hook is properly installed. This gives users a quick diagnostics command for troubleshooting setup issues before relying on more advanced features.

tour.title: Domain Error Model
tour.description: The domain layer defines the core vocabulary of the project. Here, NotFoundError extends the built-in Error class with a consistent interface for signaling that a requested resource does not exist. This pattern is fundamental to the MCP interface, where structured error responses use this class to communicate failures back to Claude Code.
tour.languageLesson: Extending the built-in Error class with a custom subclass is a JavaScript pattern for creating typed errors. Setting both the name property and the prototype chain correctly via Object.setPrototypeOf ensures that instanceof checks and error serialization work reliably across different JavaScript runtimes.

tour.title: Path Resolution Infrastructure
tour.description: Path resolution is a cross-cutting concern that every module depends on. This infrastructure module uses dependency injection to determine where the Echo workspace lives, resolving the ECHO_WORKSPACE environment variable, the echo.json configuration file, or falling back to the default .echo-workspace/ path. Centralizing path logic here prevents duplication across usecases and interfaces.
tour.languageLesson: Dependency injection decouples path resolution from its consumers. By accepting a configuration object or environment variable, this module becomes testable tests can inject fake paths without touching the real filesystem. The options bag pattern of passing a single object with named properties keeps call sites readable as configuration grows.

tour.title: MCP JSON-RPC Server
tour.description: The MCP (Model Context Protocol) server is how Claude Code communicates with Echo knowledge base at runtime. server.js implements the JSON-RPC 2.0 transport over stdio, handling request dispatching, error serialization, and response formatting. The mcp-server.js file is a backward-compatible re-export that preserves the public API while the internal structure was refactored into layers.
tour.languageLesson: JSON-RPC 2.0 is a lightweight transport-agnostic protocol. The MCP server communicates over stdio requests arrive as JSON objects on stdin with id, method, and params fields; responses carry the matching id with either a result or error object. Backward-compatible re-exports, like mcp-server.js re-exporting server.js, allow internal refactoring without breaking downstream consumers.

tour.title: MCP Tool Definitions and Query Handlers
tour.description: Tools.js registers the available operations, such as searching articles, that Claude Code can invoke through the MCP protocol. These tool definitions delegate to query-articles.js, which implements the actual search and retrieval logic against the article index. This separation keeps tool definitions thin while business logic lives in the usecases layer, following a clean architecture pattern.
tour.languageLesson: MCP tools are registered as a list of typed definitions, each with a name, description, and JSON Schema input spec. When Claude Code calls a tool, the server dispatches to the corresponding handler in the usecases layer. This follows the Interface Adapter pattern: interfaces define the contract, usecases implement the business logic, and the two are joined through simple delegation.

tour.title: Project Status and Documentation
tour.description: ECHO_STATUS.md is the living project tracker. It records the current development phase, completed milestones, and pending work items. This file gives you the high-level context: Echo converts Claude Code conversations into a searchable Markdown knowledge base through a pipeline of capture, convert, validate, index, and resolve stages, all orchestrated by the modules covered in previous steps.

tour.title: Test Suite
tour.description: Three test files cover the key modules of the project: hook installation, MCP server behavior, and health check diagnostics. These tests validate that the core usecases and interfaces work correctly, providing a safety net for refactoring. They serve as executable documentation for how each module is expected to behave and are organized to mirror the module structure under test.
